name: Persona 2: Eternal Punishment
aliases: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 2 – Eternal Punishment

locations.note: Months later in Sumaru City, the reporter Maya Amano chases the Joker Curse and uncovers the New World Order; when the city is raised into the sky as part of the spaceship Torifune, the party storms it and brings Sumaru back down.
